item.title: Exeunt 0.3.1
item.description:
A Linux beta with two new ways to shut down: OSC and text commands.

What’s new

  • Shut down over OSC. Run exeuntd osc on, then send /exeunt/shutdown/<key>.
  • Shut down with text. Run exeuntd text on, then send exeunt shutdown <key>.
  • Triggers. exeuntd triggers lists each way to shut down, with its switch.
  • Anonymous ping. Sent once a day. EXEUNT_NO_PING=1 turns it off.

Good to know

Once on, OSC uses port 9193 and Text uses port 9194. Open them in your firewall.

Help and questions: support@flatfield.co

item.title: Exeunt 0.3.0
item.description:
A beta with two new ways to shut down: OSC and text commands.

What’s new

  • Shut down over OSC. QLab or Companion can send /exeunt/shutdown/<key>.
  • Shut down with text. Crestron or Q-SYS can send exeunt shutdown <key>.
  • Triggers. Every way to shut down is in one place, each with its own switch.
  • Eos names. Primaries show their Eos names, and yours has a tick.

Good to know

OSC and Text stay off, with ports 9193 and 9194 closed, until you turn them on.

Help and questions: support@flatfield.co

item.title: Exeunt 0.3.2
item.description:
A Windows beta with two new ways to shut down: OSC and text commands.

What’s new

  • Shut down over OSC. Turn it on, then send /exeunt/shutdown/<key>.
  • Shut down with text. Turn it on, then send exeunt shutdown <key>.
  • Triggers. Every way to shut down is in one place, each with its own switch.
  • Start menu. Exeunt now has its own entry in the Start menu.

Good to know

OSC and Text start off. Exeunt sends one anonymous ping a day.

Help and questions: support@flatfield.co
